title: Payment
description: Full-viewport payment screen composing the checkout-form and order-summary blocks: the card details a shopper pays with — name on card, number, expiry, CVC and a switch to save the card — with Back to shipping and Place order, beside a read-only recap of the lines and the totals being paid for, with the payment-declined, placing-order, loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container): the masthead lines up at @sm, the footer at @md, and the order summary moves beside the payment form at @lg; each block keeps reading its own container.
